hook.text: '9 out of 10 dentists recommend...' You've heard it a thousand times. It still works because authority persuades.

buildup.text: Milgram's experiment showed people obey authority figures even against their better judgment. Titles matter.

discovery.text: Copy uses authority through credentials, expert quotes, institutional logos, and 'as seen in' media badges.

twist.text: Mere symbols of authority work. A white coat, a PhD after a name, a .edu domain—the trappings alone persuade.

climax.text: The internet made everyone a self-proclaimed expert. Now authority must be earned, not claimed, to work.

punchline.text: Show credentials, not claims. Authority must be earned.

quiz.question: What did Milgram's experiment demonstrate about authority?
options: People obey authority figures even against their judgment

details.summary: People defer to authority figures — doctors, scientists, industry experts — when making decisions. In copy, authority is signaled through credentials, data, endorsements, and confident language. A single expert quote can outweigh paragraphs of argument.
details.whyItMatters: Authority is a mental shortcut that helps people make decisions in complex domains. Understanding how to build and leverage authority ethically helps writers create more persuasive, trustworthy copy.
takeaways: Credentials and expert endorsements dramatically increase persuasion
Data and statistics signal authority even when readers don't fully understand them
Borrowed authority from trusted institutions transfers credibility to brands

faq.question: How can a new brand build authority?
faq.answer: Borrow it. Feature expert endorsements, cite research from trusted institutions, display media logos ('as seen in'), and use specific data. Even the appearance of expertise — professional design, precise numbers, confident language — increases perceived authority.

faq.question: Can authority be faked effectively?
faq.answer: Short-term, yes — which is why fake expert testimonials and fabricated credentials exist. Long-term, fabricated authority collapses when scrutinized. Genuine authority built through real expertise, transparent credentials, and honest communication is the only sustainable approach.
